headline.title: You Probably Won’t Get Rich Off the SpaceX IPO
headline.summary: SpaceX has allocated a significant portion of its shares for retail investors in its upcoming IPO, but experts caution that the potential returns for these investors may be minimal. Analysts suggest that most of the value will likely remain with institutional investors, leaving retail participants with limited gains.

articles.title: Siri won’t be your AI girlfriend
articles.summary: Apple's Craig Federighi stated that the new Siri AI is designed to avoid overly chatty or sycophantic interactions, distinguishing it from other chatbots like those from OpenAI and Google. Early testing indicates that Siri is programmed to know when to remain silent.

articles.title: Theker just raised $85M to build the factory robot that doesn’t specialize in anything
articles.summary: Theker has secured $85 million in funding to develop versatile factory robots that can be reconfigured for various tasks, moving away from the specialization of traditional humanoid robots. The company's approach aims to enhance flexibility and adaptability in manufacturing environments.

articles.title: Our new community investments in Virginia support local jobs and expand energy affordability.
articles.summary: The article outlines new community investments in Virginia aimed at supporting local job creation and enhancing energy affordability. The initiatives focus on developing a next-generation workforce and funding energy programs in the state.

articles.title: Cheaper, faster, and culturally aware, Avataar’s video AI is built for India’s scale
articles.summary: Avataar AI has launched a cost-effective video AI model tailored for the Indian market, priced at $0.005 per second of video generation. The model emphasizes speed and cultural relevance to meet the needs of India's diverse audience.

articles.title: Jeff Bezos’s Prometheus raises $12B to build an ‘artificial general engineer’ for the physical world
articles.summary: Jeff Bezos's startup, Prometheus, has secured $12 billion in funding, bringing its valuation to $41 billion. The company is focused on developing an "artificial general engineer" to automate processes in heavy engineering and drug design.

articles.title: How Preply combines AI and human tutors to personalize learning
articles.summary: Preply has integrated OpenAI technology to create AI-generated lesson summaries that offer personalized feedback and tailored language learning exercises. This approach combines the strengths of AI with human tutors to enhance the learning experience.

articles.title: Apple’s Camera Chief Thinks AI Can Give You Superpowers
articles.summary: Apple's Camera Chief Jon McCormack stated that the new generative features in iOS 27's Photos app will enhance images by adding artificial pixels, emphasizing that the company aims to use AI purposefully rather than simply for its own sake. This development reflects Apple's ongoing integration of AI technology into its products to improve user experience.

articles.title: SpaceX officially prices shares at $135 in the largest IPO ever
articles.summary: SpaceX has officially priced its shares at $135 as it launches the largest initial public offering (IPO) in history. The IPO marks a significant milestone for the company as it begins trading on the stock market.

articles.title: Why You Might Already Own SpaceX Shares, Siri’s AI Makeover, and Knicks Owner’s Surveillance Machine
articles.summary: The latest episode of Uncanny Valley discusses the potential implications of the upcoming SpaceX IPO and how some individuals may unknowingly own shares. Additionally, it covers updates on Siri's AI enhancements and the surveillance initiatives of the Knicks owner.

articles.title: Mental-R1: Aligning LLM Reasoning for Mental Health Assessment
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced Mental-R1, a new approach designed to align large language model (LLM) reasoning with human cognitive processes for more accurate mental health assessments. This method aims to improve the reliability of LLMs in evaluating conditions such as anxiety and depression, addressing a critical need for effective intervention strategies.

articles.title: Before You Think: System 0, AI-Mediated Cognition and Cognitive Colonization
articles.summary: A new paper on arXiv explores three frameworks—Tri-System Theory, Thinkframes, and System 0—related to the cognitive and epistemic impacts of artificial intelligence. It highlights System 0 as a unique theoretical approach that offers insights into AI's influence on individual reasoning and collective knowledge practices.
